# Gradmire

> Gradmire is a study-abroad counselling company for students in India. It helps students compare courses, universities, scholarships and destinations, prepare for tests, apply and plan their visas, and offers a free consultation. Registered office: World Trade Tower, Barakhamba Lane, New Delhi 110001. Email: info@gradmire.com.

## 2027 intake guides (reviewed 10 November 2026)
- [Study abroad in 2027](https://www.gradmire.com/study-abroad-2027): which intake to aim for and a month-by-month plan from November 2026
- [Study abroad intakes in 2027](https://www.gradmire.com/study-abroad-intakes-2027): typical start months by country
- [Best countries to study abroad in 2027](https://www.gradmire.com/best-countries-to-study-abroad-2027): how to compare nine destinations
- [Scholarships for the 2027 intake](https://www.gradmire.com/study-abroad-scholarships-2027): funding sources and programmes by country
- [Study abroad checklist for 2027](https://www.gradmire.com/study-abroad-checklist-2027): documents and the next 30 days
- [IELTS, TOEFL, GRE and GMAT for 2027](https://www.gradmire.com/study-abroad-tests-2027): test plan and score validity
- [MBBS abroad in 2027](https://www.gradmire.com/mbbs-abroad-2027): NEET, NMC rules and programme length by country
- [Blog](https://www.gradmire.com/blog): all guides
